text:
The real issue is the negligence of Coaching staff and Ateneo, not the players.
Ateneo is negligent because they had no knowledge of the team building activities. The office of collegiate athleticsvadmitted having no knowledge of the activity.
Then Baldwin and staff knew about the treacherous waters they were going into plus near mishaps in previous similar team buildings in the same place, yet they still chose the place.
Thevstaff was aware that the boys theyvwere bringing to that place were young amateurs with no experience on unusual sea terrain and rip currents.
The players narrated that Baldwin simply gave a theoretical orientation. How can you teach newbies on rip currents with one short theoretical lecture.
Another inquiry is if Baldwin is a certified rip current teacher.
Next they did not have a physician with them given the great risk of the place and the activity.
Furthermore, they brought only a first aid kit instead of bringing serious rescucitation equipments.
Coaching staff did not coordinate with LGU because had they coordinated, the LGU could have coordinated with coast guard and other safety agencies that could have assisted in safety and rescue.
Upon arrival in the resort, the owner of the resort specifically warned baldwin and staff not to do their activities on the sea water because of the already known dangers.
Instead of heeding the warning, baldwin and staff brushed the warning aside and even told resort owner to leave them alone because they dont want to be disturbed and that theyvdid not want to be seen.
On the day of their team building, they travelled 300 meters away from the resort way beyond the reach of lifeguards.
The players were not made to wear lifevests, no lifesavers, no standby boats for possible rescue.
When the incident happened, staff did not know what to do.
Then it took them a long time to notify and get help that is why it took around 40 minutes to recover the bodies of Baterbonia and Adili.
On the beach, the rescucitation measures were chatic because there was no medic and proper equipments.
The victims were brought to a hospital that was 30 minutes away from the resort where they were declared dead on arrival.
After the incident, there were multiple attempts to muddle and hide the truth.
THIS IS THEVREAL ISSUE OF NEGLIGENCE AND RECKLESS IMPRUDENCE RESULTING TO DOUBLE HOMICIDE.
THIS IS THE TRUTH.

video_title: In the Public Square: Ateneo, what happens now?
text:
The whole  process is devoid of empathy and insight to what “these kids where exposed to” and continue to be exposed to by subjecting them to interviews that  “look into the facts” at the expense of exposing these players’ vulnerabilities at a time they are still acutely traumatized and reliving their acute symptoms of PTSD and survivors guilt in real time during a clueless “fact finding” interview. It was not only retraumatizing to these players but to anyone viewing who understands/ has undergone trauma and the somatic scars it leaves behind. There was even no warning on the content of the interview that it could activate vulnerable viewers. Why was the burden of clarifying the “truth” passed on to the players. Whatever happened to mental health professionals more adept in “communicating”
and clarifying these matters at the same time educating the public,taking this responsibility on behalf of the players. And now “these kids are exposed to” the backlash this interview will create in social media from toxic content creators and trolls feasting on their vulnerabilities by punching their credibility in a public forum. How does this help in the process of social re-integration these players will eventually need to move on from this traumatic event  in the future. On another level this is moral injury for trusting once again the people they believe have their best interest at heart who should know better. That now  exposes them and us to a rip tide of disparaging public opinion. That only aggravates the desensitization we already have to contend with to discern the truth at the cost of our basic human dignity and self-respect. This is not intended to polarize or blame but to create awareness and hopefully clarity from the trauma informed social scientists, public and mental health professionals skilled in compassionate inquiry. It’s also high time to look into moral injury that is inflicted by the betrayal of trust experienced from institutions we rely on for our safety and wellbeing. Although this happens so much more often than we realize for the ordinary Filipino barely trying to survive. In every chaos there is always an opportunity to heal. There is wisdom in setting limits to what can be divulge in a traumatic event that touches us deeply as this has and where our institutions seemed to have failed us. It just heightens the meaning of accountability and response-ABILITY that is congruent with the truth that can truly liberate and transform our consciousness.
